src/app/(auth)/actions.ts.name: Sign in and out
src/app/(auth)/actions.ts.description: Signs a person in, signs them up or signs them out through Supabase.

src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx.name: Sign-in page
src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx.description: The sign-in and sign-up form, or a setup notice when Supabase isn't configured.

src/app/api/health/route.ts.name: Pre-demo check
src/app/api/health/route.ts.description: Reports whether Supabase is connected and whether demo mode is on.

src/app/example/actions.ts.name: Example job actions
src/app/example/actions.ts.description: Creates a sample job, runs it in the background and deletes it again; part of the template's example.

src/app/example/auto-refresh.tsx.name: Example auto-refresh
src/app/example/auto-refresh.tsx.description: Refreshes the example page every few seconds while a job is still running.

src/app/example/page.tsx.name: Example page
src/app/example/page.tsx.description: The template's example screen: sign in, start sample jobs and watch them finish.

src/lib/jobs.ts.name: Example job work
src/lib/jobs.ts.description: The placeholder work a sample job does; nothing in Sentinel uses it.

src/lib/supabase/admin.ts.name: Supabase full-access connection
src/lib/supabase/admin.ts.description: Connects to Supabase with the secret key, bypassing per-user rules; only the example page uses it.

src/lib/supabase/client.ts.name: Supabase connection (browser)
src/lib/supabase/client.ts.description: Connects to Supabase from the browser; nothing uses it yet.

src/lib/supabase/env.ts.name: Supabase settings
src/lib/supabase/env.ts.description: Reads the Supabase address and public key in one place, and says whether they are filled in.

src/lib/supabase/server.ts.name: Supabase connection (server)
src/lib/supabase/server.ts.description: Connects to Supabase on the server as the signed-in person, and looks up who that is.

src/proxy.ts.name: Keep people signed in
src/proxy.ts.description: Refreshes each visitor's Supabase sign-in on every request so pages see a valid one.

GET /api/health.name: Pre-demo check
GET /api/health.description: Replies whether Supabase is connected and whether demo mode is on.
